process.title: From a local campaign to a warm investor on your desk

steps.d: We collect and organise your full investment documentation, then turn it into the knowledge base behind an AI chat. Investors get reliable answers in their own language, grounded solely in the developer's material.
We segment by what people actually do, not what they say.
Our moderator hosts the discussion. You present and answer questions live.
You receive an investor with a full intent profile and take the process from there, on your own or with our help.
We share contacts to verified law firms in the target market. That kind of backing earns investor trust.
Investors come back to future webinars for their next purchase, and they bring their friends.

You get demand, data, and direct contact with your clients. What you avoid is another salesperson standing between you and the buyer, juggling a portfolio of listings without deep knowledge of any of them.

tech.title: The webinar as a source of data, not an address list
tech.sub: At the heart of Vesteri sits our own webinar and AI platform, built around three things nobody else offers. Every campaign teaches the system a little more about what leads to a purchase.

cards.d: It answers investor questions on the spot, in their language. It knows every project in the portfolio in depth, works during the webinar, and keeps working long after. You never explain the same thing for the twentieth time, and you never worry that an agent forgot a detail or simply did not know it.
The platform records which project holds a participant's attention, what they ask, what they skip, and when they leave. A single meeting produces a profile of real interest.
The system rates how ready each participant is to buy and passes on only those who clear the qualification bar, together with a full record of their questions and interests.

buyers.faq02: Clear answers about listings, agents and buying property.
buyers.faq04: Vesteri Collective is a community of independent real estate agents and agencies working under their own brands. They share Vesteri Market, professional service standards, cooperation on transactions and Vesteri Channels — a space for learning, conversation and exchanging experience — with Vesteri agents. Approved agents publish listings in Vesteri Market.
buyers.faq05: How is Vesteri Market different from other property portals?
buyers.faq06: Vesteri Market brings together local and international listings published by Vesteri agents and approved Collective agents. They all follow shared standards for accurate information and client service. Buyers contact the agent presenting their chosen property directly.
buyers.faq07: Can I search for local property as well as property abroad?
buyers.faq08: Yes. Vesteri is intended for local and international property searches, subject to listings actually available in each market. Explore Vesteri Market or contact a participating agent for guidance.
buyers.faq09: How do I contact an agent about a property?
buyers.faq10: Open the property listing in Vesteri Market and use the contact option provided. The listing agent can answer questions about the property, available viewings and next steps. Agree the scope of services and terms directly with the agent.
buyers.faq11: Can I buy directly through Vesteri or a Collective member?
buyers.faq12: Yes. The transaction is handled by the agent named on the listing: a Vesteri agent or an independent Collective member. Vesteri may also directly represent selected international developments. Transaction arrangements vary by property and country.
buyers.faq13: Are all properties legally verified by Vesteri?
buyers.faq14: No. Before approving agents to publish listings in Vesteri Market, we review their professional activity and acceptance of our shared standards. This does not mean that every property has automatically undergone legal or technical due diligence. Selected overseas properties offered directly by Vesteri may undergo a different review process, but buyers should still confirm exactly what has been checked. We plan to expand buyer support, such as helping find an independent lawyer for property due diligence or providing guidance through a purchase. These services are not yet guaranteed for every transaction. Before buying, always consider independent legal and technical checks of the property.
buyers.faq15: How do I buy property abroad safely?
buyers.faq16: Check ownership, legal documentation, applicable taxes, financing rules, the developer’s background and the total cost of purchase. Use qualified, independent legal advisers in the relevant jurisdiction. Vesteri Market does not replace legal due diligence, but we can support your process, including helping you find independent legal advisers and connecting you with people in our network who can assist. The assistance available depends on the property and destination.
buyers.faq17: Can I speak with the seller during a LIVE viewing or webinar?
buyers.faq18: Yes, when they take part in the event. Vesteri and Collective agents can organise LIVE viewings and webinars with developers or other sellers. You can then ask questions both of the agent and of the seller directly. Check the event description for its topic and participants.
buyers.main15: More from every deal. Less work outside selling.
buyers.main16: Join Vesteri and rely on the back office of a modern agency: technology, marketing and a network of cooperating agents. Or join Collective and work under your own brand.

agents.faq02: About the agency model, Collective, LIVE viewings and the 3+1 programme.
agents.faq03: What is the difference between a Vesteri agent and a Collective member?
agents.faq04: A Vesteri agent works in the agency model: they use the Vesteri back office and keep 70–80% of the commission. A Collective member works under their own brand, may use the designation “Member of Vesteri Collective”, uses Vesteri Market at the price list and settles with clients independently. Both groups can cooperate with each other.
agents.faq06: Each month starts at 70%. The first qualifying LIVE viewing or webinar on Vesteri Market gives you 73%, the second 77% and the third 80% for that month. The details are set out in your agreement.
agents.faq07: Do I pay a subscription for the platform?
agents.faq08: No. A Vesteri agent pays only for LIVE viewings and webinars, at the agent discount. No LIVE events are included in the price. You will learn the price and the discount before signing the agreement. Ad campaigns managed by Vesteri are optional and billed separately.
agents.faq09: Who signs the brokerage agreement with the client?
agents.faq10: Vesteri. You look after the client and the transaction as a Vesteri agent. A Collective member signs agreements independently, under their own brand.
agents.faq11: What counts as a LIVE viewing or webinar?
agents.faq12: An event held on Vesteri Market that meets the conditions written into your agreement. You receive the criteria in writing before you sign.
agents.faq13: Do I have to invite other agents?
agents.faq14: No. The 3+1 model is voluntary. Network payments arise only from commissions on transactions closed by invited agents, never for the invitation itself.
agents.faq15: Does the 3+1 model reduce my commission?
agents.faq16: No. It is funded from Vesteri’s share. Your post-split commission is only the base for the calculation.
agents.faq17: What amount are the 3% and 1% calculated on?
agents.faq18: On the commission of the agent who made the sale, after the split with Vesteri. With a commission of PLN 20,000 and a 70% share the agent keeps PLN 14,000, so 3% is PLN 420 and 1% is PLN 140.
agents.faq20: No. We show you working tools and assess their effectiveness on real listings. Results depend on your activity and the market.
agents.faq21: Can I move from Collective to the agency model?
agents.faq22: Yes. Your Vesteri Market account and Channels access stay the same. The agreement and the way you are paid change.
agents.faq25: How much does Collective membership cost?
agents.faq26: You use Vesteri Market at the price list. You will receive the price list before signing the agreement, and it forms part of that agreement. To find out the prices, email collective@vesteri.com.
agents.faq27: Does a Collective member have to cooperate with other agents?
agents.faq28: Consent to cooperate with Vesteri agents and other Collective members is a condition of membership. Agents agree the commission split for each transaction between themselves.

meta.title: Agent benefits calculator | Vesteri
meta.description: Enter your own results and compare your current model with Vesteri: a 70–80% share, LIVE and ad costs and the 3+1 programme. A simulation, not an earnings forecast.

calculator.intro: Enter your real results. Compare your current model with Vesteri 70/30, see the path to 80% and the potential of additional network income. No promises of unproven sales growth.
calculator.avgHint: Average gross commission per transaction: {avg}. We assume one commission per transaction, without automatically doubling it for both sides.
calculator.current: How much of the commission do you keep today? (%)
calculator.currentHint: For example 50% on a 50/50 split, 100% if you work on your own.
calculator.costNowHint: Costs outside the commission split in your current model.
calculator.costVHint: The same as your current costs by default. Change it if some costs fall away.
calculator.adsBudgetHint: The amount spent on Meta/Google ads.
calculator.adsFeeHint: Editable. The rate depends on the plan: 10%, 7%, 5% or 3%.
calculator.adsNote: The ad budget and the management fee are separate costs. Per year: budget × 12 × (1 + fee rate).
calculator.levelIntro: Every LIVE viewing or webinar held on Vesteri Market in a given month raises the commission share for that month: 0 LIVE = 70%, 1 = 73%, 2 = 77%, 3 or more = 80%. The counter resets at the start of each month.
calculator.livePriceHint: The price of one LIVE viewing or webinar before the discount. No LIVE events are included.
calculator.livesMonthHint: The number of events you plan each month.
calculator.discountHint: The Vesteri agent discount from your agreement. A single rate; 0% means no discount.
calculator.levelNote: A Vesteri agent pays only for LIVE events. Annual LIVE cost = standard price × (1 − discount) × LIVE events per month × 12. To be paid at 80% for a month, you need at least 3 LIVE events in it. The counter starts from zero the following month.
calculator.growth: Change in the number of transactions with Vesteri (%)
calculator.growthHint: 0% by default. Growth is a simulation, not a forecast or a guarantee.
calculator.teamDeals: Average transactions per agent per year
calculator.teamShareHint: From 70% (no LIVE events) to 80% (3 LIVE events in a month).
calculator.networkNote: We assume the same average property value and commission rate as above. Level 1: 3% of agents’ commission after the split with Vesteri; level 2: 1%. Funded from Vesteri’s share, without reducing the share of the agents making the sales.
calculator.resultTag: Annual difference against your current model
calculator.descSame: With the number of transactions unchanged.
calculator.descGrowth: Includes a simulated change in the number of transactions of {pct}%.
calculator.descAds: After the ad budget and management fee.
calculator.better: In this scenario Vesteri comes out {amount} a year better.
calculator.betterTail: The result depends on the commissions, costs and sales you entered.
calculator.worse: In this scenario your current model comes out {amount} a year better.
calculator.worseTail: That is useful to know: it is worth checking which costs or benefits would really change the result.
calculator.ladderNote: Commission is settled at the end of each month according to the number of LIVE viewings and webinars held in that month. Each new month starts at 70%.
calculator.rowIncomeNow: Your part in the current model
calculator.breakEvenHeading: How many transactions does it take to break even?
calculator.breakEvenText: Transactions per year with Vesteri needed to match your current result after costs, at the same average commission and your current Vesteri share.
calculator.moreText: Vesteri Market, AI that helps answer clients’ questions, LIVE viewings and webinars, interest qualification, a CRM and cooperation on listings can help reduce administrative work and improve client service.
calculator.moreStrong: We test their effect in practice; we do not add it to the calculator without data.
calculator.disclaimer: The calculator is an illustrative tool, not a binding offer, tax advice or an earnings forecast. Results are before taxes and social contributions and include only the costs you enter. The LIVE discount lowers the cost and is not added to income a second time. Your own costs with Vesteri are deducted from the Vesteri result, just as your current costs are deducted from the current model. The ad budget and management fee are added as Vesteri costs; no equivalent spending is assumed in the current model unless you included it in your current annual costs. A Vesteri agent pays no subscription; only LIVE events are paid, at the agent discount. The 70–80% model and 3+1 are shown according to Vesteri’s assumptions. In the 3+1 simulation every network agent has the same average number of transactions, commission and share; actual results may differ. The 3% and 1% amounts are calculated on the commission of the agent who made the sale, after the split with Vesteri. VAT, differences in how commission is settled, onboarding costs and changing webinar qualification rules are not included. The annual simulation assumes the same number of LIVE events and transactions every month. Actual settlement should take the number of LIVE events and the transaction commission into account separately for each month. The LIVE counter resets every month.
